derived_from: T11 (columns mode: same view, shared scale, shared baseline, label per column)

adopted_rules: same orientation repeated so the difference reads
headline separated from the product area
excluded_elements: 'not to scale' note (the poses are one product at one true scale)

adopted_rules: identical angle and rhythm across the states

tokens.palette_note: accent comes from the job palette; a light accent (L>0.4) turns the eyebrow and step numbers to --muted

fonts.display: Archivo 850 wdth 114% (headline), 800 wdth 108% (state labels), en uppercase

type_scale_px_at_1500.state_label: 50 down to 42 (one size for all labels; >= 10px at 360 wide)

job_fields.headline: required; zh keeps the author's line breaks
job_fields.poses: [{asset, label}] 2-3 states, rest pose first, labels in the page language
job_fields.shared_frame: default true: pictures of one size share one frame

adaptation_rules: every pose is the same camera at the same display scale: pictures of one size are placed identically, so the fixed parts line up and only the moving ones change
columns: the poses side by side on one baseline, step number and state name under each, a thin accent arrow between columns
rows: very wide products (a caliper, a tape pulled out) stack, the step number and name in a left column joined by a thin downward arrow
auto picks rows only when it shows the product at least 18% larger than columns
one label size for all poses, at most two lines, never below 10px at 360 wide
a frame that would cross the canvas edge shrinks the shared scale (3% steps); upscale capped at 1.25
no offer chip, no 'not to scale' note
limitations: the poses come from the pose agent (articulation.py); the template draws what it is given and claims nothing about range
